top_performing_topics: Asset Valuation (Buying undervalued vs. overpriced assets)
winning_hook_formulas: The 'Stop/Warning' Imperative: Start with a negative command + a specific, high-stakes financial consequence (e.g., 'Stop doing X before you lose Y').
The 'Hidden Loss' Reveal: Highlight a common financial product and frame it as a 'trap' that is actively draining the viewer's net worth (e.g., 'Your X is secretly making you poorer').
script_directives: Maintain a strict 20-22 second duration to maximize completion rates.
Use high-contrast visual cues (charts or red/green text overlays) every 3 seconds to reset viewer attention.
Eliminate fluff; start the value proposition within the first 1.5 seconds and maintain a fast-paced, urgent tone throughout.
seo_directives: Use high-intent, contrarian keywords in the title that challenge common financial wisdom (e.g., 'Trap', 'Stop', 'Secretly').
Limit hashtags to 3-4 highly relevant, niche-specific tags (e.g., #Nifty50, #StockMarketIndia, #PersonalFinance) to avoid algorithmic dilution.
